description: Mode (3) classified adaptive: LOW=30s stills (no_activity + environmental_noise), MID=10s stills (uncertain local activity), HIGH fires one 1080p/30fps ~10s video clip on strong local activity (then back to MID, with cooldown). A clip is a confirmation aid for strong local activity, NOT a confirmed pollinator visit. Live only with POLLIPI_LIVE_ADAPTIVE_ENABLED=1 AND /start live_adaptive_requested=true.
